body:
Eden Simmer, Executive Vice President and Head of Global Equities at PIMCO, has launched a new investment firm, UpLevel Impact Ventures, according to her LinkedIn profile. Simmer established UpLevel Impact Ventures in October 2026 and lists herself as Founder and Managing General Partner. She has spent more than 16 years at PIMCO, where she has served as Executive Vice President and Head of Global Equities since January 2019, based in New York. Simmer has not confirmed when she will leave PIMCO, and her LinkedIn profile continues to list her position at the asset manager alongside her new role at UpLevel Impact Ventures. Previously, Simmer was Senior Vice President and Head of Americas Equity Trading from October 2010 to December 2018. She also held an equities trading role during her early years at the firm. Before joining PIMCO in 2010, Simmer spent nearly three years at Deutsche Asset Management as an Equities and Foreign Exchange Trader.

Citadel has promoted Hugh Lindsey to Head of Electronic Execution within its Equity Quantitative Research (EQR) business, according to his LinkedIn post. Based in New York, Lindsey assumed the role in September 2026, following more than five years at the hedge fund. He previously served as Chief Operating Officer of EQR Alpha from April 2024 to September 2026, overseeing activities across research, trading and engineering. His responsibilities included portfolio construction, optimization, market impact modeling and electronic execution. Before moving into the COO position, he spent more than three years as a Quantitative Trader in Citadel’s EQR business in London.

State Street has appointed Jane Kizhner as Managing Director and Head of Digital Asset Solutions for North America, according to a LinkedIn post. Kizhner joined the firm in October 2026 and is responsible for leading its digital asset strategy, product innovation and commercialization efforts across North America. Before joining State Street, Kizhner served as Head of Strategy, Wealth and Investment Management at Broadridge Financial Solutions from May 2025 to June 2026, overseeing strategy, business development, platform innovation and commercialization initiatives. Previously, she was Head of Partnerships, Digital Assets at Cross River from November 2021 to December 2023.

Guggenheim Securities has announced that Rafael Schnitzler will join the firm as a Senior Managing Director in its Telecom & Digital Infrastructure investment banking practice, according to a press release. Schnitzler will be based in Guggenheim’s New York office and will commence work at the firm in June. Schnitzler will join Guggenheim with approximately 15 years of investment banking experience in the telecom sector. He most recently served as a Managing Director in the Strategic Advisory Group at PJT Partners, where he covered communication infrastructure clients.

Bullish, an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services, has appointed Stacey Cunningham, former President of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), as President, according to a press release. Cunningham brings decades of financial markets experience, including serving as President of NYSE Group, where she became the first woman to lead the exchange group. During her tenure, she also held senior leadership roles including Chief Operating Officer, overseeing technology modernization and the integration of multiple exchange acquisitions. Previously, she held senior roles at Nasdaq. Cunningham serves on the boards of internet infrastructure and cybersecurity provider Cloudflare, the New York Stock Exchange, and Georgetown University’s Psaros Center for Financial Markets and Policy. She has served as an operating partner at the global private equity firm Advent and an advisor to Uniswap Labs, the digital asset technology provider.

GTN has appointed Mark Jennings as global head of digital assets. Jennings will lead GTN’s strategy to support tokenised securities through its global market access. According to a press release, he joins GTN from Gemini, where, as CEO of Gemini Europe, he led the exchange’s European expansion. Before that, he held senior roles at Kraken, including CEO of Crypto Facilities, its FCA-regulated derivatives venue for institutional clients.
